text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I did it... I really did it...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I won!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ... I lost.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Tannhauser-san gave me a push, so I 
thought maybe I'd gotten stronger, but...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-Bourbon-san!?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
That was a wonderful race. I just wanted 
to tell you that.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I'll be able to return shortly. So let us 
fight together once more.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...! Yeah... yeah!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text: Congratulations on a splendid victory!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, thank you very much. I'm so happy!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
People like McQueen-san and Rice-san just 
had this overwhelming presence.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't sure how things would go, but I'm 
just glad I was able to do my best.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text:
"By the way, have you decided on your next 
target race?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Umm, I was hoping I could run on a big 
stage like this one next time too.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
So as expected, I'd really love it if I 
could run in the Takarazuka Kinen~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Whoa...!)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best so I can win next time 
too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, her next race was decided to be 
the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Phew... The track is so peaceful in the 
morning.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, the Takarazuka Kinen is 2200m on turf 
clockwise, right? Which means—
Haaaah――!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant*...! Not yet...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I need to grow a lot too, just like 
Rice-san and Tannhauser-san...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
All my regrets from the Tenno Sho (Spring) 
will be poured right into the Takarazuka 
Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Incredible... McQueen is shining so 
bright...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Mun. Alright, I've gotta do my best 
too...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Days of relentless training began, all 
aimed at the GⅠ middle-distance Takarazuka 
Kinen two months away!
